KKR Acquires Medicover India's Hospital Network for $1.4 Billion

Private equity firm KKR has acquired Medicover India's network of 24 hospitals for approximately $1.39 billion to $1.4 billion, or €1.2 billion. This acquisition signals growing private equity interest in India's healthcare sector, which is experiencing rapid growth. The deal is part of an acceleration in hospital consolidation and expansion by larger chains into smaller cities.
